clips.title: The story
paras: Defeat Nek'rosh marks the culmination of the Alliance campaign against the Dragonmaw clan in the Wetlands. With their siege engines sabotaged, adventurers are ordered to strike down Chieftain Nek'rosh directly to secure Menethil Harbor. Bringing his severed head back to Captain Stoutfist shatters the orcish threat to the coastal port.

The Dragonmaw orcs have long plagued the marshlands of Khaz Modan, entrenched within their fortified encampments and threatening the sea lanes of Menethil Harbor. After discovering and burning the clan's catapults, the defenders of the marsh strike straight at the head of the serpent. Chieftain Nek'rosh, commander of the local warband, stands as the final obstacle to breaking the siege. His demise strips the remaining Dragonmaw raiders of their tactical coordination.

Returning Nek'rosh's severed head to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor marks an enormous victory for Ironforge's garrison. Deprived of both their heavy siege weaponry and their chieftain, the Dragonmaw are dealt a blow from which they are unlikely to quickly recover. For the beleaguered port, which serves as the Alliance's primary lifeline between Lordaeron and Khaz Modan, the chieftain's fall ensures the docks and trade vessels remain safe from sudden assault.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that the catapults have been burned, find and kill Chieftain Nek'rosh.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Stoutly done, friend. You have dealt a telling blow to the Dragonmaw orc clan. They may never recover. And the destruction of those catapults has made Menethil Harbor safe.
You are a traveler of merit, and the kingdom of Ironforge rewards those who serve it well.
